question: In covering a distance of 110 km, Pranay takes 6 hours more than Aman. If Pranay doubles his speed, then he would take 5 hours less than Aman. Pranay's speed is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Pranay's** initial speed be **s** and doubled speed be **2s**. Speed ratio → 1 : 2.

Since distance is constant, **Time ratio** is inverse of Speed ratio → 2 : 1.

Difference in time units = 2 − 1 = 1 unit.

Actual time difference = 6 hours (more) + 5 hours (less) = 11 hours.

∴ 1 unit = 11 hours. Initial time (2 units) = 22 hours.

**Pranay's speed** = Distance ÷ Initial Time = 110 ÷ 22 = 5 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf64d82a3fb919d513ca05bb674a243f1de0781719d5709d8f2f2c7535f2bf94.png] 

**Given:** Total Distance = 110 km. Let **Aman's** time be **TA**.

**Formula Used:** Time = Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Let **Pranay's** original speed be **x** km/hr.

⇒ Case 1: 110/x = TA + 6

⇒ Case 2: 110/(2x) = TA − 5

⇒ Subtracting Case 2 from Case 1: (110/x) − (110/2x) = (TA + 6) − (TA − 5)

⇒ 110/2x = 11

⇒ 110 = 22x

⇒ x = 110 ÷ 22 = 5 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relationship

When **Distance** is constant, Speed is **inversely proportional** to Time (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Average Speed Formula

If a person covers two equal distances at speeds **u** and **v**, then **Average Speed** = 2uv/(u + v).

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the **same direction**, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. In **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.</p
